params.name: panel_t
params.comment: printed wall thickness (PETG); 2.5 to 4 mm

params.name: fit_gap
params.comment: per side, housing cavity over the plate edges; 0.1 to 0.5 mm

params.name: x_half
params.comment: plate / housing inner half-width (x = -x_half back ... +x_half front); 45 to 70 mm

params.name: plate_bot
params.comment: world y of the mount plate's bottom edge (from the clutch/tray layout); fixed by feed_unit.py

params.name: plate_top
params.comment: world y of the mount plate's top edge (from the standoffs/guard); fixed by feed_unit.py

params.name: cap_cut
params.comment: W where the end cap starts (shell, hood and door end here); 200 to 260 mm

params.name: w_end
params.comment: W of the end wall's outer face (set by the mains tray in feed_unit.py); 300 to 330 mm

params.name: r_long
params.comment: outer radius of the long edges, also the 45-degree top-front chamfer's leg; 8 to 15 mm

params.name: r_bottom
params.comment: outer radius of the two bottom long edges; 6 to 10 mm

params.name: r_end
params.comment: 45-degree chamfer round the end wall (the end cap's bed face); 6 to 10 mm (more than panel_t + 1)

params.name: lap
params.comment: how far the seam's laps run on (cap over the shell, hood over the cap); 5 to 12 mm

params.name: lap_t
params.comment: thickness of the lapped skins; 0.8 to 1.5 mm (less than panel_t)

params.name: lap_g
params.comment: clearance under each lap; 0.1 to 0.4 mm

params.name: chamfer_in
params.comment: inside legs of the housing's top 45-degree chamfers (derived)

params.name: split_y
params.comment: door / shell split: top of the bottom fillets (derived)

params.name: band_y
params.comment: world y of the bottom of the hood's control strip; -40 to -10 mm

params.name: tray_w1
params.comment: W of the mains tray's end face (inlet panel); up to w_end - r_end - 1

params.name: cap_block_t
params.comment: end cap's screw blocks: thickness from the wall (M3 insert 6 deep); 7 to 10 mm

params.name: cap_block_h
params.comment: end cap's screw blocks: height (along y); 10 to 20 mm

params.name: cap_block_reach
params.comment: end cap's screw blocks: reach past cap_cut into the shell; 15 to 30 mm

params.name: inlet_y
params.comment: world y of the IEC inlet's centre in the mains tray's end face (derived: halfway up the raised tray)
